description: A dimensional warrior who stepped through Voidreach's rift and returned forever half-phased, flickering between planes to absorb attacks that pass through their shifting form.
icon_hint: heavy shield half-phased into a dark purple void rift
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy voidwalker dimensional warrior class. Heavy dark border half-phased into void, left side solid iron, right side dissolving into purple void particles. Deep space black center with swirling dark purple void energy and dimensional rift cracks. Small half-phased shield at bottom. Color palette: void black, deep purple, dimensional blue. No characters, no text.
